msg: Hi! We're a group of 6 friends from the UK. 4 of us are PADI open water certified and 2 just want to snorkel. We're staying in Getsemani in Cartagena. Is there a group discount? Thinking of this Saturday.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! That sounds like a lovely day out in the Rosario Islands 🌊 Yes, your group can combine certified diving and snorkeling on the same trip. Snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites, and the group may travel together or be split by activity.

There’s an extra *10% group discount for groups of 5 or more* on recreational diving and snorkeling; the team applies it. The online prices already include a separate 10% online discount. For reference, from Cartagena, 2 dives are *$178 USD per diver online*, and snorkeling is *$126 USD per person online*.

For Saturday, choose the date and quantities in the booking links; the system shows the available booking options. You’ll meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. Getsemaní is close to the historic center, but transport to the dock isn’t included.

Book 2 dives: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en · Book snorkeling: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

Anyone who is not Colombian or a resident of Colombia (without a Colombian ID) pays in USD by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

I recommend the *2 dives in 1 day* plan in the Rosario Islands. (If you'd rather a *multi-day package* of 3+ dives, just tell me.)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: no, we all dived last year. saturday works. how do we get the group discount if we book online? do we pay first and get refunded?
reply:
No refund is needed. The *10% online discount* is applied automatically when you book on our website. The extra *10% group discount for groups of 5 or more* isn’t automatic, so please contact our team to have it applied. It applies to recreational diving and snorkeling, and stacks with the online discount.

After more than 2 years without diving, a refresher is normally needed before the dive; a refresher or PADI ReActivate completed at another center counts.

You can book online and the team can help apply the group discount—there’s no discount code. Would you like me to share the booking links again?
